text:
Yes. I found several Texas providers who specifically list **emetophobia** and/or use **exposure therapy/Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP)**:

- **Kim Rockwell-Evans, PhD — Richardson/Dallas area:** Lists emetophobia as a specialty and offers CBT, exposure therapy, and telehealth throughout Texas. Her practice is **OCD and Anxiety Specialists of Dallas**. ([findyourtherapist.adaa.org](https://findyourtherapist.adaa.org/people/kim-rockwell-evans?utm_source=openai))
- **Bethany Bosier — CalmOCD:** Based in Texas and provides telehealth. She lists emetophobia/phobias among the conditions treated and uses ERP for OCD and anxiety-related problems. ([calmocd.com](https://www.calmocd.com/therapist/bethany-bosier?utm_source=openai))
- **Kimberly Wilson — Plano, online across Texas:** Specifically lists emetophobia and says her approach includes exposure-based therapy and ERP. ([psychologytoday.com](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/kimberly-wilson-plano-tx/933370?utm_source=openai))
- **Gretchen Bice, LPC-A — telehealth across Texas:** Provides CBT with ERP for anxiety and OCD-related disorders; the International OCD Foundation verifies the provider listing and licensure information. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/pre-licensed_trainee/bice-gretchen-m/?utm_source=openai))
- **Amitai Abramovitch, PhD — Austin/telehealth:** An OCD and anxiety specialist whose treatment is primarily ERP; this may be especially appropriate if your emetophobia involves intrusive thoughts, compulsions, or reassurance-seeking. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/abramovitch-amitai/?utm_source=openai))

When contacting them, ask:

> “Do you regularly treat emetophobia using gradual exposure or ERP, including avoidance and safety behaviors? Do you see clients by telehealth in my Texas location, and do you accept my insurance?”

Availability, fees, and insurance participation can change, so confirm those details directly. Exposure should be planned gradually with a trained clinician rather than attempted abruptly or without support.
